contract_notes: On create, a missing runtime and runtime.type=pipeline preserve existing pipeline behavior; on update, an omitted runtime preserves the current runtime.
A new GPT-Live create requires data.llm.model.
The pipeline-to-live update keeps the existing data.llm unless explicitly changed.
The live-to-pipeline update explicitly supplies stt and voice; it does not infer them from runtime.voice.
GPT-Live input omits legacy stt, data.voice, parallelSTT, and speech preferences marked legacy/incompatible by the current schema; do not remove data.speech wholesale.
GPT-Live reads may omit stt/voice or return them as null.

A custom voice_ reference is illustrative schema/catalog shape only, must pass current organization-visible ownership checks, and is not executable until an organization-scoped runtime mapping exists; an arbitrary ID grants no access.
Flow node LLM overrides remain under flow.nodes[].data.llm.
